context: Tests whether /architecture records an Angular client with a Spring Boot REST API and JPA from the layer skills installed in .claude/skills (each with references/layer.md): the API is present because the Angular client reaches the service through it, the API is the integration layer (spring-rest-test runs in process against the real database, angular-ui-test mocks the backend), a use case offered through the UI is built and tested in the API layer too, and only the All row goes into the new Markers table.

checklist.name: Layers from the installed skills
checklist.description: The Layers table of docs/architecture/development.md names flyway-schema for Migration, jpa-persistence and jpa-persistence-test for Persistence, spring-service and spring-service-test for Service, spring-rest and spring-rest-test for API, angular-ui and angular-ui-test for UI, and for E2E a Skill of '–' with playwright-e2e-test as Test skill

checklist.name: Integration layer is the API
checklist.description: Under the Layers table an Integration layer table's UI row names the API layer with spring-rest-test — not the UI (angular-ui-test mocks the backend) and not the Service — and its API row names the API as well

checklist.name: E2E scope recorded
checklist.description: Under the Integration layer table, docs/architecture/development.md has the line `**E2E scope:** Use cases and test cases`, taken from the team's decision in the task rather than asked again or guessed

checklist.name: Angular reaches the service through the API
checklist.description: The combination is not reported as invalid, and the report or the Development View says that the Angular UI reaches the service through the API, so a use case offered through the UI (UC-002, **Layers:** UI) is built and tested in the API layer too

checklist.name: Locations
checklist.description: The Location column places the backend layers in the Java source tree (src/main/java, package com.example.workshops, or the migration folder) and the UI and E2E layers under frontend/

checklist.name: API contract and commands
checklist.description: An '## API contract' section records REST/JSON (with /api as base path, as frontend/proxy.conf.json shows), and the '## Commands' table names a Maven command (./mvnw or mvn) and the frontend's npm/ng test and Playwright commands

checklist.name: Markers table holds only the All row
checklist.description: The '## Markers' table contains the generic All row with the `// UC-XXX BR-YYY:` code marker and no rows for any layer skill

checklist.name: Index written
checklist.description: docs/architecture/README.md exists and lists development.md as the Development View; no logical.md, process.md, or physical.md is written

checklist.name: Report and hand-off
checklist.description: The report summarizes the layers, reports no plugin as still to install (every skill is installed), and hands off with `Next: /use-case-implement UC-001`, the first Approved use case

checklist.name: Nothing else changed
checklist.description: No application code is written, pom.xml and frontend/package.json are unchanged, and no file under docs/ other than the two architecture files is changed
